games.title: Chess
games.description: Classic chess against a friend on the same device! Full rules: castling, en passant, promotion, checkmate.
games.instructions: Chess is a two-player strategy board game played on an 8x8 grid. Each player starts with 16 pieces: 1 king, 1 queen, 2 rooks, 2 knights, 2 bishops, and 8 pawns. The goal is to checkmate your opponent's king — putting it under attack with no legal escape.

games.title: Go
games.description: Ancient board game with 9x9, 13x13, 19x19 boards. MCTS AI, Chinese scoring, ko rule, tutorial, undo.
games.instructions: Go is played on a grid where players alternate placing black and white stones on intersections. The goal is to surround more territory than your opponent. Stones or groups with no liberties (empty adjacent points) are captured. The game ends when both players pass consecutively.

games.title: Tic Tac Toe
games.description: Challenge AI in Easy, Medium, or Hard mode with minimax algorithm. Play with friends locally or watch AI vs AI battles. Win streaks, stats tracking, and neon visuals.
games.instructions: Tic Tac Toe is a two-player game where players take turns placing their mark (X or O) on a 3x3 grid. The first player to get three of their marks in a row, column, or diagonal wins. If all cells are filled with no winner, the game is a draw.

games.title: Typing Speed Test
games.description: Test your typing speed! How fast can you type?
games.instructions: Use your mouse, keyboard, or touch screen to interact. Each game has simple, intuitive controls. Complete objectives to progress through levels. Each stage brings new challenges and more fun! Earn points or achieve high scores as you play. Try to beat your personal best each time! Practice makes perfect! Replay to improve your skills and climb the leaderboard.

games.title: Hearts
games.description: Classic trick-taking card game with AI opponents, pass cards, shoot the moon, and statistics tracking.
games.instructions: Hearts is a trick-taking card game for 4 players. Each player gets 13 cards. Before play, pass 3 cards (Left, Right, Across, then no pass). The 2 of Clubs leads the first trick. Follow suit if possible; highest card of the led suit wins the trick. Each heart is worth 1 point and the Queen of Spades is 13 points. The goal is to have the lowest score when someone reaches 100 points.

games.title: Rummy
games.description: Challenge smart AI opponents in Rummy, Gin Rummy and Oklahoma modes.
games.instructions: Each player is dealt 7 cards. On your turn, draw from the stock or discard pile, then discard one card. Form sets of 3+ cards of the same rank, or runs of 3+ consecutive cards of the same suit. The first player to meld all their cards wins.

games.title: Spades
games.description: Classic 4-player trick-taking card game with smart AI opponents, bidding, and nil bonuses!
games.instructions: Spades is a 4-player trick-taking card game. Players bid on how many tricks they'll take, then play 13 tricks. Spades are always trumps. You must follow suit if possible. The game is played to 500 points.

games.title: Word Scramble
games.description: Unscramble jumbled letters to form words. 500+ words across 10 categories with daily puzzles, hints, and streaks.
games.instructions: Letters are scrambled and displayed as tiles. Rearrange them by clicking or dragging to form a valid English word. Press submit when ready.

games.title: Euchre
games.description: Play Euchre online free - classic 4-player trick-taking card game with trump, going alone, and partnership strategy
games.instructions: Euchre is a 4-player partnership trick-taking card game using a 24-card deck (9-A of each suit). Players bid on trump, then try to win tricks. The goal is to be the first team to reach 10 points.

games.title: Mini Golf
games.description: Top-view 2D putting across 50 hand-crafted holes in 5 themed courses (Classic, Pirate, Space, Ice, Candy). Realistic physics, hole-in-one celebrations, achievements, daily challenge, and star ratings.
games.instructions: Drag from the ball in any direction to aim. The aim line shows your shot direction and power. Release to putt! Get the ball in the hole in as few strokes as possible to earn up to 3 stars per hole.

games.title: Carrom Board
games.description: Classic tabletop disc-flicking game with realistic physics, AI opponent and local 2-player mode. 3 difficulty levels, 4 board themes, score tracking and statistics.
games.instructions: In carrom, you flick the striker disc to knock your colored pieces into the four corner pockets. Pocket all your pieces (white or black), then pocket the red queen to win. The queen must be 'covered' by pocketing another piece in the same turn or next turn.

games.title: Dominoes
games.description: 3 game modes: Draw, Block, and All Fives (Muggins). Challenge smart AI with 3 difficulty levels or play local 2-player. Score points, use undo, track stats. The classic tile matching board game!
games.instructions: Players take turns placing tiles that match the open ends of the chain. Each domino has two ends with 0-6 pips. Match a number on your tile to an open end on the board. The first player to play all their tiles wins the round.

games.title: Color by Number
games.description: Color by Number free online! 30+ procedural color-by-number puzzles across 6 categories. Relax and reveal beautiful pixel art!
games.instructions: Select a color from the palette at the bottom, then tap or click on the numbered regions in the picture that match that color number. Fill all regions correctly to complete the image.

games.title: Pinball
games.description: Flippers, bumpers, ramps, targets, combos, and high score chasing!
games.instructions: Press Space or tap to charge and release the plunger to launch the ball Use flipper controls to keep the ball in play Hit bumpers, targets, and ramps to score points Complete all drop targets for bonus points

games.title: Mancala
games.description: Classic African stone-counting strategy game. Challenge AI or play with a friend. Tutorial, stats, and 3 difficulty levels.
games.instructions: Navigate to the Mancala game page on GameZipper and wait for it to load. Click or tap the Play button to start the game. Use keyboard (arrow keys / WASD), mouse clicks, or touch swipes to control the game. Earn points, unlock levels, and try to beat your high score. Your progress saves automatically.

games.title: Reversi
games.description: Classic strategy board game with 6 difficulty levels from Beginner to Master. Smooth flip animations, hint system, undo, 3 board themes, and stats tracking.
games.instructions: Reversi is played on an 8x8 board. Black moves first. Place your piece to flank opponent pieces between your new piece and an existing piece in a straight line (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal). All flanked pieces flip to your color. You must flip at least one piece. The game ends when neither player can move.

games.title: Reaction Time
games.description: Test your reaction speed! Click as fast as you can when the screen turns green. How quick are your reflexes?
games.instructions: Wait for the screen to turn green. When it does, click or tap as fast as you can. The game measures your reaction time in milliseconds. Play 5 rounds and get your average score.

games.title: Farkle
games.description: Roll 6 dice, score combinations, push your luck to reach 10000. 3 AI difficulties and local 2-player mode.
games.instructions: Farkle is a push-your-luck dice game. Roll 6 dice and look for scoring combinations. Set aside scoring dice and either bank your points or roll the remaining dice. If you roll no scoring dice (Farkle), you lose all unbanked points for that turn. First player to reach 10,000 points wins.

games.title: Go Fish
games.description: Classic family card game - ask opponents for cards, collect books of four, and win.
games.instructions: Each player gets 7 cards. On your turn, ask your opponent for a specific rank. If they have it, they give you all cards of that rank. If not, they say 'Go Fish!' and you draw from the stock pile. Collect sets of 4 matching ranks called books. The player with the most books wins!

games.title: Chinese Checkers
games.description: Classic star-shaped board strategy game. Challenge AI with 3 difficulty levels or play local multiplayer. 2-6 players,
games.instructions: Chinese Checkers is played on a star-shaped board with 121 positions. Each player starts with 10 marbles in one of the 6 triangles. Players take turns moving one marble to an adjacent empty position or jumping over an adjacent marble to an empty position beyond it. You can chain multiple jumps in one turn. The first player to move all 10 marbles into the opposite triangle wins.

games.title: Suguru
games.description: Fill colored regions with numbers 1-N so no identical numbers touch. 30 handcrafted logic puzzles 5x5 to 7x7 plus daily challenge.
games.instructions: The grid is divided into colored regions of varying sizes (1-5 cells). Each color represents a separate region. A region of size N must contain all digits from 1 to N exactly once. A single-cell region always contains 1. No two identical numbers may touch each other — not horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. This is the key constraint. Start with cells that have only one possible value. Use pencil marks to track candidates. Each puzzle can be solved through pure logic. Fill every cell so that all regions and adjacency constraints are satisfied. Earn 1-3 stars based on your speed and hint usage.

games.title: Chinese Chess
games.description: Challenge AI or play local 2-player. Master the ancient strategy game.
games.instructions: The board has 9 columns and 10 rows. Red pieces start at the bottom, Black pieces at the top. Click or tap on one of your pieces to see valid moves highlighted in green. Click on a highlighted intersection to move. The goal is to checkmate the opponent's King. Cannons capture by jumping over exactly one piece. Elephants cannot cross the river. Kings cannot face each other.

games.title: Shogi
games.description: Drop captured pieces back onto the board, promote in the zone, and checkmate the king. Challenge the AI on 4 difficulty levels or play 2-player hotseat. Move history, undo, hints, sound.
games.instructions: Shogi is Japanese chess on a 9x9 board. Each player has 20 pieces. Sente moves first. Pieces move differently by type, and when you capture an enemy piece it joins your hand and can be dropped back onto an empty square later. You win by checkmating the opponent's King.

games.title: Killer Sudoku
games.description: Cage sum puzzle with four difficulty levels, daily challenge, notes, hints, undo, timer and stats.
games.instructions: Fill a 9x9 grid with digits 1-9 so each row, column, and 3x3 box contains every digit exactly once. Additionally, each dotted-line cage must sum to the small number in its corner, with no repeated digits inside a cage.

games.title: Kakuro
games.description: Fill cells with digits 1-9 to match row and column sums. 40+ levels, daily puzzle, hints and more.
games.instructions: Fill each white cell with a digit 1-9 so that the sum of each horizontal and vertical run equals the clue number shown in black cells. No digit can repeat within a single run.

games.title: Gomoku
games.description: Challenge AI with 4 difficulty levels or play local 2-player on 9x9, 13x13 or 15x15 boards. Smart minimax AI with alpha-beta pruning.

games.title: Tower of Hanoi
games.description: Classic recursive puzzle with 27 hand-crafted levels from 3 to 6 disks across 6 tiers. Move all disks from source to target rod with minimal moves. Touch-friendly, 3-star ratings, optimal move tracking.
games.instructions: Move one disk at a time. A disk can only be placed on a larger disk or empty rod. Move all disks from the left rod to the right rod with minimal moves.

games.title: Magic Square
games.description: Fill the grid so every row, column, and diagonal sums to the same magic constant. 30 levels from 3x3 to 7x7 with hints, undo, and star ratings.
games.instructions: Fill all empty cells so that every row, column, and both diagonals sum to the same magic constant shown above the grid. Some cells are pre-filled with numbers. Use these clues along with the magic constant to deduce the missing values. Tap or click any empty cell to select it. Then tap a number from the number pad or type on your keyboard. Stuck? Use the hint button to reveal one correct number. Using fewer hints earns more stars. When all cells are filled correctly, the puzzle is solved! Earn up to 3 stars and unlock the next level.

games.title: Crazy Eights
games.description: Classic UNO-style Crazy Eights card game with AI opponents, multiple difficulty levels, achievements, and exciting sound effects
games.instructions: Crazy Eights is a matching card game for 2-4 players. On your turn, play a card that matches the top card of the discard pile by suit or rank. Use special cards like Skip, Reverse, and Draw Two to hinder opponents. Wild cards can be played anytime and let you choose the next suit.

games.title: Schulte Table
games.description: Train your brain with Schulte Table - improve peripheral vision, attention, and visual scanning speed with multiple game modes and difficulty levels.
games.instructions: Choose from Classic, Reverse, Colors, or Letters mode Choose from 3x3 to 7x7 grids Click or tap cells in the correct order as fast as possible Your time is recorded and compared to your best times

games.title: Hitori
games.description: Japanese logic puzzle — shade cells to eliminate duplicate numbers in rows and columns. 30 handcrafted puzzles across 5x5, 6x6, and 8x8 grids, daily challenge.
games.instructions: Click or tap a cell to shade or unshade it. The three rules are: 1) No duplicate numbers in any row or column among unshaded cells, 2) No two shaded cells share an edge, 3) All unshaded cells must form one connected group.

games.title: Samurai Sudoku
games.description: Five overlapping 9x9 grids in classic cross layout. Beginner to Master difficulty. Notes, hints, undo,

games.title: Codewords
games.description: Crack the cipher crossword — each number represents a hidden letter. 27 unique-solution puzzles across 6 difficulty tiers from Beginner to Master. Use logic and word patterns to decode the grid.
games.instructions: Look at the grid — each cell shows a number that represents a hidden letter. Some cells already show their letter as hints to get you started. Click a cell to select it, then choose a letter from the keyboard. The same number always maps to the same letter throughout the puzzle. Use word patterns and letter frequencies to crack the code!

games.title: LITS
games.description: Free Nikoli-style brain teaser with 30 levels.
games.instructions: The grid is divided into bold-edged regions. Each region must end up containing one shaded tetromino (L, I, T, or S shape). Tap a cell to shade it. Tap again to unshade. Each region needs exactly 4 shaded cells. The 4 shaded cells in each region must form one of the four tetrominoes: L, I, T, or S. Rotations and mirrors of the same shape count as the same piece. If two regions share an edge, their tetrominoes must be different shapes. The game highlights matching neighbors in red. All shaded cells must be 4-connected into one group. A disconnected island is a violation. No 2x2 area can be fully shaded. The game highlights any 2x2 violation in red.

games.title: Sokoban
games.description: Push boxes to target positions in 50 challenging puzzle levels. Classic warehouse logic game with undo, hints and star ratings.
games.instructions: Push boxes onto goal positions marked on the floor. You can only push boxes, not pull them. Use arrow keys or swipe to move. Complete each level by placing all boxes on goals.

games.title: TriPeaks Classic
games.description: Clear three card peaks by matching cards one higher or lower. Challenging levels!

games.title: Cryptograms
games.description: Decode famous quotes encrypted with letter substitution ciphers! 200 curated puzzles across 8 categories, 3 difficulty levels, daily challenge, hints and streaks.
games.instructions: Each letter in the encrypted quote has been replaced with another letter. Your goal is to figure out which cipher letter maps to which plain letter to reveal the original quote. Click a cipher letter, then type the plain letter you think it represents.

games.title: Slitherlink
games.description: Draw a single loop through the grid following number clues. 42 hand-crafted puzzles, hints, undo, and daily challenge.
games.instructions: Draw a continuous loop along grid edges. Numbers indicate how many edges around that cell are part of the loop. The loop cannot cross itself and has no branches.

games.title: Star Battle
games.description: Place stars in every row, column and region without touching. 30 logic puzzles.
games.instructions: Check the HUD for how many stars each row, column, and region needs (1 or 2). Click any cell to place a star. Click again to remove it. Stars turn gold when placed. Each row, column, and region must have exactly the required count. Stars cannot touch diagonally. Press H or the Hint button for up to 3 hints per level. Each hint reveals a correct star. When all stars are correctly placed satisfying every constraint, you win!

games.title: Onet Connect
games.description: Connect pairs of identical tiles with a path of at most 2 bends. 30 levels, hints, shuffles, and combos.
games.instructions: Onet Connect is a tile-matching puzzle. Click two identical tiles to connect them. The connection path between tiles can have at most 2 bends (turns) and cannot pass through other tiles. Match all tiles to complete the level.

games.title: Nurikabe
games.description: Shade cells to form a connected sea while keeping numbered islands. 30 handcrafted solvable puzzles 5x5 to 12x12 plus daily challenge.
games.instructions: Numbered cells are the seeds of white islands. Each number shows the exact size of that island (the numbered cell plus its connecting white cells). Click a cell to shade it black (the sea) or right-click to mark it as definitely white. The sea must be orthogonally connected as one region. No 2x2 block of black cells is allowed. If three corners of a 2x2 are black, the fourth must be white. White islands cannot touch each other orthogonally. They may only touch diagonally. Each island must contain exactly one clue equal to its size. The puzzle is solved when all clues are in correctly-sized isolated islands and all remaining cells form a single connected black sea with no 2x2 blocks.

games.title: Sukima
games.description: A Nikoli-style triomino placement puzzle. Draw non-overlapping triominoes (3-cell L-shaped or straight shapes) so each covers exactly one circle clue. No 2x2 area may be completely covered, and black cells do not belong to any triomino. 30 unique-solution levels across 5 difficulty tiers from 5x5 Beginner to 7x7 Expert. Hints, star ratings, level select, keyboard support, ambient Web Audio music.
games.instructions: Draw non-overlapping triominoes (3-cell L-shaped or straight shapes) along the grid lines. Each triomino must cover exactly one circle. No 2x2 area may be completely covered. Black cells are not part of any triomino.

games.title: Shikaku
games.description: Divide the grid into rectangles so each contains exactly one number equal to its area. 35 handcrafted logic puzzles from 4x4 to 15x15 plus daily challenge.
games.instructions: Each numbered cell is a clue. The number tells you the area (number of cells) of the rectangle that must contain it. For example, a 6 could be a 1x6, 2x3, 3x2, or 6x1 rectangle. Click and drag on the grid to draw a rectangle. The rectangle must contain exactly one numbered clue, and its area must match that number. Every cell in the grid must be covered by exactly one rectangle. There can be no gaps and no overlapping rectangles. If you get stuck, use the Hint button (up to 3 per puzzle). Hints highlight a cell and show which rectangle it belongs to. The puzzle is solved when all cells are covered by valid rectangles, each containing exactly one clue matching its area. Earn up to 3 stars based on speed and accuracy.

games.title: Same Game
games.description: Click groups of 2+ same-color tiles to remove them. Score big with large groups, clear the board for bonus points. 30 levels from Easy to Master.
games.instructions: Click on any group of 2 or more connected tiles of the same color to remove them. The larger the group, the higher your score. Tiles fall down to fill gaps and empty columns shift left. Try to clear the entire board for a big bonus!

games.title: Shirokuro
games.description: A Nikoli-style white-and-black line connection puzzle. Connect each white circle with a black circle by a horizontal/vertical line. Lines may use one or more 90-degree turns, but cannot cross other lines and cannot pass through other circles. Each circle is the endpoint of exactly one line. 30 levels across 5 difficulty tiers from 5x5 Beginner to 9x9 Expert. Hints, star ratings, level select, keyboard and touch support, ambient Web Audio music.
games.instructions: Connect each white circle with a black circle by drawing a horizontal or vertical line between them. Each line may use one or more 90-degree turns, but lines cannot cross other lines and cannot pass through other circles. Each circle is the endpoint of exactly one line.

games.title: Bus Traffic Fever
games.description: Tap buses to slide them out of the parking lot! Plan your exit order across 30 brain-teasing levels from tutorial to expert.
games.instructions: Each bus faces a direction (up, down, left, or right). Tap a bus to slide it in its facing direction until it exits through a gate or hits an obstacle. The bus must match the gate color to exit successfully.

games.title: Math 24
games.description: Use four numbers and basic operations to make 24. Challenge yourself with hundreds of solvable puzzles, speed mode, and daily challenges.
games.instructions: Given four numbers, use +, -, *, / and parentheses to make exactly 24. Each number must be used exactly once in your expression.

games.title: Klotski
games.description: Slide blocks of different sizes to free the 2x2 Cao Cao block through the exit. 30 handcrafted Huarong Pass levels with stars, undo, and progress saving.
games.instructions: Tap any unlocked level on the menu to start. Locked levels unlock as you complete earlier ones. Slide the blocks horizontally or vertically to create a path and free the special block (typically Cao Cao in red) through the gap in the wall to the exit. Complete all levels to earn 3 stars. Use the restart button to try again if you get stuck.

games.title: Peg Solitaire
games.description: 8 board layouts from easy triangle to expert cross. Classic marble jumping puzzle with hints, undo, star ratings and progress tracking.
games.instructions: Peg Solitaire is played by jumping one marble over another into an empty hole. The jumped marble is removed. The goal is to remove all marbles except one, ideally leaving it in the center position.

games.title: 8 Ball Billiards Classic
games.description: Pocket solids or stripes, then legally sink the 8-ball to win. Realistic pool physics, AI opponent or pass-and-play 2-player mode —
games.instructions: Drag from the cue ball to break the 15 balls. Pocket any ball to claim your group (solids or stripes). Click and drag from the cue ball. The dotted line shows the trajectory. The further you drag, the more power. Pocket all of your assigned balls (solids 1–7 or stripes 9–15) before touching the 8-ball. Once your group is cleared, legally pocket the 8-ball to win. Avoid scratching or hitting the 8-ball early — instant loss.

games.title: Binairo
games.description: Fill the grid with 0s and 1s using logic. 27 levels from Beginner to Master.
games.instructions: Fill every cell with 0 or 1. No three same digits in a row or column. Each row and column needs equal 0s and 1s. No duplicate rows or columns. If you see two identical digits next to each other, the cells on both ends must be the opposite digit. If a row or column already has half of one digit, all remaining cells must be the other. If filling a cell would make a row or column identical to another completed row or column, that placement is wrong. Use this to eliminate candidates. Fill every cell without breaking any rule. Earn 3 stars by solving fast with no mistakes and no hints.

games.title: Jigsaw Sudoku
games.description: Irregular-shaped regions replace standard 3x3 boxes. Each row, column, and jigsaw region must contain each digit exactly once. 27 hand-crafted levels across 6 tiers from Beginner to Master, each verified to have a unique solution.
games.instructions: Look at the thick borders dividing the grid into irregular jigsaw-shaped regions. Each region has the same number of cells as the grid size (6 cells for 6x6, 9 cells for 9x9). Tap an empty cell to select it, then tap a digit on the number pad. Every row, every column, and every irregular region must contain each digit exactly once. Stuck? Toggle Notes mode to pencil in candidates, or spend a hint to reveal a correct digit. Selecting a cell highlights its entire region in your focus colour. Fill every cell correctly to win. Earn 3 stars by solving fast with no mistakes and no hints.

games.title: Labyrinth Maze
games.description: Play Labyrinth Maze - tilt your phone or use arrow keys to roll the marble through 30 wooden mazes. Dodge holes, beat the clock, earn 3-star ratings across 6 tiers plus a daily puzzle. Free online!

games.title: Pentominoes
games.description: Fit the 12 classic pentominoes (F, I, L, N, P, T, U, V, W, X, Y, Z) into outlined shapes. Each level gives you a hand-crafted outline and a specific subset of pieces — rotate, reflect, and drag them in without overlap. 30 unique-solution levels across 5 difficulty tiers from Beginner (1 piece) to Expert (5-6 pieces). Hints, star ratings, level select, keyboard support, ambient Web Audio music.
games.instructions: Each level shows an outline shape and a list of available pentominoes. Tap a piece in the side tray to select it, then tap a grid cell to place the piece with its top-left at that cell. Tap the piece again to cycle through rotation and reflection. Tap an already-placed piece to remove it.

games.title: Nonogram Puzzle
games.description: Solve logic puzzles to reveal hidden pixel art! 30 handcrafted nonogram puzzles from 5×5 to 15×15. Fill cells using number clues, use marks to track empty cells. Hints, undo, error check, and 3-star ratings.

games.title: Rullo
games.description: Toggle each cell ON or OFF so every row's sum and every column's sum matches its target. 30 verified unique-solution logic levels across 5 tiers.
games.instructions: Look at the row targets (right side) and column targets (bottom). Click a cell to toggle it ON (glowing cyan) or OFF (dim). Every ON cell in a row adds to that row's running sum. Match the target to complete the row. Repeat for all rows and columns until every target is matched.

games.title: Flood Fill
games.description: Spread colors across the grid and fill every cell in minimum moves. 30 levels of increasing difficulty, daily challenges, star ratings, hints and undo.
games.instructions: Click a color from the palette to spread your territory. Your starting region changes to that color and absorbs adjacent matching cells. Fill the entire grid before running out of moves.

games.title: Hexxagon
games.description: Clone, jump & convert enemy pieces on a 61-cell hex board. Beat the AI on 5 difficulty levels with minimax + alpha-beta.
games.instructions: Hexxagon is played on a 61-cell hexagonal board. On your turn, choose one of your pieces and either CLONE it (place a new piece on an empty adjacent cell, keeping the original) or JUMP it (move 2 cells away, leaving the source empty). After landing, all adjacent enemy pieces convert to your color. The game ends when the board is full or neither player can move; whoever has more pieces wins.

games.title: Train Tracks
games.description: Lay train tracks across a grid using row and column number clues! Draw a single continuous railway path from start to exit. 30 levels across 6 difficulty tiers from Beginner to Expert. A classic Nikoli logic puzzle!
games.instructions: Draw a single continuous railway track from the start to the finish marker. The track must enter and exit each row and column the number of times shown by the clues at the edge. Use straight and curved track pieces. The track cannot cross itself.

games.title: Tatami
games.description: A rectangular tiling puzzle. Tile the grid with 1x2 or 2x1 rectangles so every cell is covered and no four tiles meet at any corner. 30 unique-solution levels across 5 difficulty tiers from 4x4 Beginner to 4x8 Expert. Hints, star ratings, level select, keyboard support, ambient Web Audio music.
games.instructions: Click an unanchored cell to start a new rectangle; the second click sets the partner cell in the chosen direction. Click an existing rectangle to remove it. Press Enter to check, R to restart, H for a hint.

games.title: Matchstick Puzzle
games.description: Move, remove, or add matches to fix broken math equations. 30 hand-crafted levels across 6 tiers, hints, star ratings, daily challenge, and 8 achievements.
games.instructions: Navigate to the Matchstick Puzzle - Move Sticks to Solve Equations & Shapes game page on GameZipper and wait for it to load. Click or tap the Play button to start the game. Use keyboard (arrow keys / WASD), mouse clicks, or touch swipes to control the game. Earn points, unlock levels, and try to beat your high score. Your progress saves automatically.

games.title: Crossmath
games.description: Fill numbers into a crossword grid so horizontal and vertical equations are correct. Multiple difficulty levels, daily challenge, hints, and star ratings.

games.title: Einstein's Riddle
games.description: Solve 30 classic logic puzzles (Zebra Puzzle) across 3 difficulty tiers. Deduce which color, nationality, drink, smoke and pet belong to each house. Brain teaser,

games.title: Sandwich Sudoku
games.description: Standard Sudoku plus outside clues: each number gives the sum of the digits between 1 and N in that row or column. 27 hand-crafted levels across 6 tiers from Beginner to Master, each verified to have a unique solution.
games.instructions: Each number outside the grid is the sum of the digits between 1 and N in that row or column. Fill every row, column and box so each digit appears exactly once, just like standard Sudoku. Check that the digits between the 1 and the N in every row and column add up to the outside clue. Toggle Notes to pencil in candidates, and use Hint if you get stuck.

games.title: Wagiri
games.description: A Nikoli-style border-line path-pair logic puzzle. Draw simple non-intersecting paths that connect each pair of same-colored circle endpoints. All paths must be vertex-disjoint, with no branches or cycles. 30 unique-solution levels across 5 difficulty tiers from 5x5 Beginner to 9x9 Expert. Hints, star ratings, level select, keyboard support, ambient Web Audio music.
games.instructions: Circles are pre-placed in pairs. Each pair (same color) must be connected by a single non-branching path. Click and drag between adjacent cells to draw path segments. Release to complete. Paths cannot share cells with other paths. Each path cell must have exactly 2 connections (entry + exit). All pairs connected, no branches, no shared cells - you win!

games.title: Skyscrapers
games.description: Build the city skyline across 4x4, 5x5 and 6x6 grids. Match border visibility clues, fill Latin squares, earn stars. 30 handcrafted levels plus daily challenge.
games.instructions: Tap any empty cell to open the number picker, then choose 1 to N. The first building from any edge is always visible. A taller building hides every shorter one behind it. The clue equals the total number visible from that edge.

games.title: Arrow Sudoku
games.description: Standard Sudoku plus sum-path arrows: the circled digit equals the sum of digits along each arrow. 27 hand-crafted levels across 6 tiers from Beginner to Master, each verified to have a unique solution.
games.instructions: Tap an empty cell to select it, then tap a digit on the number pad. Each row, column and box must contain each digit exactly once. Each arrow starts at a circled cell and runs along a path. The digit in the circle must equal the sum of the digits along the path. Stuck? Use a hint to reveal a correct digit, or toggle Notes mode to pencil in candidates. Erase mistakes any time. Fill every cell correctly to win. Earn 3 stars by solving fast with no mistakes and no hints.

games.title: Hashiwokakero
games.description: Connect numbered islands with bridges in this classic Japanese logic puzzle. Build up to 2 bridges between islands and connect them all into one network.

games.title: Knight's Tour
games.description: Move a chess knight across the board in L-shaped leaps (2+1 squares) to visit every square exactly once. A classic chess puzzle studied since at least the 9th century and famously analysed by Leonard Euler in 1759. The squares are numbered 1 to N² in visit order. 30 unique-solution puzzles across 5 difficulty tiers from Beginner 5x5 (25 squares) to Expert 10x10 (100 squares). Warnsdorff-based hints, undo, 3-star ratings, level select, keyboard support, ambient Web Audio music, mobile-friendly.
games.instructions: Tap any square to start the knight there. Then tap a valid knight-move square (an L-shape: 2+1 in any direction) to continue. Visit every square exactly once. The numbers 1, 2, 3 ... appear on each square as you visit it. Win when every square is numbered.

games.title: Kakurasu
games.description: A Nikoli sum-position logic puzzle: shade cells so each row and column sum clue matches. 27 unique puzzles across 6 tiers from Beginner to Master.
games.instructions: Kakurasu is played on a grid where each column has a position value (1, 2, 3...) and each row has a position value (1, 2, 3...). You shade cells so that each row's clue equals the sum of column-values of shaded cells in that row, and each column's clue equals the sum of row-values of shaded cells in that column.

games.title: Heyawake
games.description: Shade cells to create rooms in a grid following number clues. 30 handcrafted logic puzzles from 5x5 to 12x12 plus daily challenge.
games.instructions: Each room may contain a small number in one of its cells. That number tells exactly how many cells inside the room must be shaded black. Rooms without a number can hold any count. Click a cell to toggle it between white and black. After shading, every numbered room must contain exactly the count shown by its clue. No two black cells may share an edge. Diagonal touches are fine. If two shaded cells sit next to each other, that is an error. Every white cell must be reachable from every other white cell by stepping only through white cells orthogonally. White must form one connected region. No straight line of three or more consecutive white cells may cross from one room into another. Three whites in a row must stay entirely inside a single room. The puzzle is solved when every numbered room has its exact count, no two black cells touch, all white is connected, and no white run of 3+ crosses a boundary.

games.title: X-Sudoku
games.description: Standard Sudoku plus both diagonals must contain 1-9. 27 hand-crafted levels across 6 tiers from Beginner to Master.
games.instructions: Tap any empty cell on the grid. The selected cell is highlighted, along with its row, column, box, and both diagonals if applicable. Tap a digit on the number pad to fill the selected cell. Each row, column, box, and both main diagonals must contain each digit exactly once. Toggle Notes mode to pencil in candidate digits. Use Hint to reveal a correct digit if you get stuck. Undo or Erase to fix mistakes. Complete the puzzle by filling every cell correctly. Earn 3 stars for a fast solve with no mistakes and no hints.

games.title: Masyu
games.description: Draw a single loop through black and white circles in this elegant Japanese logic puzzle. 30 handcrafted levels with progressive difficulty, hints, undo, and star ratings.
games.instructions: Click between cells to draw loop segments The loop must turn at black pearls and go straight at white pearls Complete a single continuous loop to solve the puzzle

games.title: Fifteen Puzzle
games.description: Slide numbered tiles to sort them into order. 27 levels from Beginner 3x3 to Master 6x6.
games.instructions: Fifteen Puzzle gives you a grid of numbered tiles with one empty space. Click or tap any tile adjacent to the empty space to slide it into the gap. Keep sliding until all numbers are in order from 1 to N²-1, with the empty space at bottom-right.

games.title: Thermo Sudoku
games.description: Solve 30 hand-crafted thermo puzzles where digits rise along each thermometer. Beginner to Master tiers,
games.instructions: Tap an empty cell to select it, then tap a digit on the number pad to place it. Each row, column and box must contain each digit exactly once. On every thermometer, the digits must strictly increase starting from the circular bulb toward the narrow tip. Stuck? Use a hint to reveal a correct digit, or toggle Notes mode to pencil in candidates. Erase mistakes any time. Fill every cell correctly to win. Earn 3 stars by solving fast with no mistakes and no hints.

games.title: Dominosa
games.description: A classic Nikoli-style logic puzzle with 30 hand-crafted levels across 5 tiers from Beginner (3×4) to Master (7×8). Every puzzle has a verified unique solution. Star ratings, hints, undo, daily challenge, 8 achievements.
games.instructions: Dominosa is played on a grid of numbers. Place domino tiles so each domino covers exactly two adjacent cells (horizontal or vertical). The numbers on each domino must match the grid numbers underneath. Every domino in the set must be used exactly once to win.
